column1: # Every child-route mode (child, strict = GAMMALOOP_IR_HARD_DEPTH_STRICT=1, guard = GAMMALOOP_IR_HARD_CHILD_GUARD=1)
# is expected to give the same disposition. A profile row overrides the '*' row.
# Profiles: pr19 (r6-nf1 env), u7bk3i (U7b, GAMMALOOP_UNCONTRACTED_NUMERATOR=check:ir-hard + strict: K3 checked),
# u7bk3on (U7b, on:ir-hard: K3 used), u7bk3c (U7b, check:root,child,ir-hard + strict, the rv-a-L3-check profile).
# quotient_vertex_numerator, quotient_edge_numerator: the pole is read (contracted traces, d = 4-2eps), B = 2
# hard_numerator (vertex v0, edge 7, and v0 with every row hidden): explicit read, the others refused
# numerator_prefactor (root_projector, root_normalisation): beta refuses a non-regular weight before R*
# overall_factor: beta refuses a non-regular weight; the regular neighbours are computed
# projector: any projector other than 1 fails the input stage ("early color factoring requires amputated external sources")
# propagator_power: the DOT format holds an integer only ("invalid DOT attribute 'power'")
# u7bk3c: the U7b K2 (UV-child) CHECK fails first, on both routes, on every non-explicit quotient or hard spelling
# (open U7b item, not IRH): "UNCONTRACTED_CHECK kind=child ... differs ... through eps^-1" for the 1/(d-4) forms and
